title: Form factors for your new AI coworkers — Craig Wattrus, Flatfile
talk_summary: A design-lead talk about how Flatfile builds AI 'coworkers' across four form factors (invisible, ambient, inline, conversational), emphasizing 'feeling the material' of models by building small throwaway harnesses to probe their behavior. It is mostly product/UX philosophy with a few transferable practices around prompt experimentation and agent character tuning.

takeaways.technique: Prompt A/B harness for agent personas
takeaways.what_they_do: Builds a tiny throwaway app (V0 'chat tuner') that loads an agent's system prompt and lets you swap variants (friendly/balanced/concise/cautious) to feel how the model's behavior changes before committing.

takeaways.technique: Personal benchmark apps to 'feel the material'
takeaways.what_they_do: Creates small purpose-built benchmark apps (e.g. 100 autocomplete suggestions) to compare models on a specific task rather than trusting general benchmarks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: this is a a a benchmark or something that I've created just for myself to be able to feel the materials

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of patching individual bad outputs ('it shouldn't say this'), they treat the agent as a character to coach, shaping its disposition via the system prompt.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I realized I needed to go from controlling um to being a character coach

takeaways.technique: Structured agent output UX (visual confirm, snapshot, rollback)
takeaways.what_they_do: Redesigns agent output to show what it's doing visually, ask for confirmation, take a snapshot for rollback, and state next steps, instead of dumping a wall of text.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I'm aligned. I took a snapshot. You can roll back. I'm holding you accountable. You approved this.

takeaways.technique: Knowledge-base-grounded suggestions that hand back to humans
takeaways.what_they_do: Loads customer call transcripts and docs into a knowledge base; the agent then surfaces fixes it can't perform itself and tells the human how to unblock it.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the agent decided I can't fix this but I know how to fix it and so I'm going to tell you how to fix it
